description: Render the diagram in the preview and return it as a PNG image, so you can see your own result. Call this once after drawing or heavily editing a complex diagram, then fix overlaps and edges that cross shapes. Without a page selector it shows the page on screen; with one it renders that page without changing what the user sees. Needs the preview tab to be open.

page_id.description: Target a page by its id (as returned by list_pages or add_page). Wins over page_name and page_index when multiple are set.

page_index.description: Target a page by its 0-based tab index. Used only when page_id and page_name are not set.

page_name.description: Target a page by its display name (e.g. "CNN"). Used only when page_id is not set.

name: screenshot_diagram
title: Screenshot diagram
